recovery_evidence: Engineering sensitivities, not demonstrated low-gravity process yields. Retention is fraction of the feed element entering a recoverable process stream; separation acts on that inventory; finishing is elemental mass retained to nominal refined product, not a purity percentage. Same sensitivities compare routes without claiming identical chemistry or simultaneous plant capacity.
grade_evidence: Explicit low/middle/high geological transfer scenarios around the chosen analogue, not empirical quantiles. CI factors span a broader range than the compiled chondritic mean comparisons, allowing target heterogeneity and selection. KREEP factors vary a selected enriched lithology; they do not assign its abundance or area on the Moon.
metal_rich_pt_evidence: 10 ppm is the approximate iron-meteorite distribution mode and ~40 ppm a commonly reached high grade in Harries 2024, not an upper bound; 1 ppm is an explicit poor-grade stress. No frequency or other-PGM ratio is inferred.
lunar_patch_evidence: Illustrative 100 km2, 5 m worked-depth bulk-mass scenario from lunar_potential result; density-only quantiles. A KREEP-like site of this area has not been identified or qualified. Output bounds combine density quantiles and explicit grade factors, not a joint probability interval.
